song.name: March of the Legion
song.plot: The Legion of Souls is unleashed across Nythoria. The corrupted horde — Nythorians lost to the Void's influence and the damned souls Nyktoros commands — marches under the black sun. The war anthem of the invasion.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: the Legion of Souls (collective "we") — the corrupted horde of the Void, conscripted souls from the banked sacrifices. Voice of the Legion; the Legion speaks for Nyktoros, never in his first person. Anchors: the Legion of Souls, Nythoria, the Void as master, souls conscripted, the banked souls of the sacrifices (soul-leak canon), the fall of light. Short punchy 6-8 syllable lines, driving war rhythm. No named individual heroes, no Rift, no Eldoria, no Anya, no Seraphina, no Valen. Structure: Verse → Chorus → Verse → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus → Outro. Suggested Suno direction: relentless march — double-kick drums, war horns, chanting crowd vocals.

section.name: Verse
section.reworked: From the vaults of the dead, Banked souls rise and march. Nythoria bows her head, Under the black sun's arch.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: March of the Legion, the Void calls, We are the shadows, we break the walls. Conscripted souls in endless night, We are the end of every light.

section.name: Verse
section.reworked: The Master's voice is cold, His hunger drives us on. A thousand thousand sold, The light is overrun.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: March of the Legion, the Void calls, We are the shadows, we break the walls. Conscripted souls in endless night, We are the end of every light.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: The sky is torn, the sun has died, The storm is ours, the world defied.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: March of the Legion, the Void calls, We are the shadows, we break the walls. Conscripted souls in endless night, We are the end of every light.

section.name: Outro
section.reworked: March... march... We are the end of every light.
